features.label: Forms under tension
features.explanation: Preserve identity and actions while moderately emphasizing angular changes in form and asymmetry
features.evidence: The tilt of the head, neck and shoulders, together with local asymmetries, creates a sense of instability.
features.zh: 在保留身份与动作的前提下，适度强化形体转折与不对称
features.en: Preserve identity and actions while moderately emphasizing angular changes in form and asymmetry

features.label: Tense angular lines
features.explanation: Express tension in the forms through angular lines of varied weight
features.evidence: Contours around the neck, jaw and eyes tighten and turn sharply.
features.zh: 用有轻重变化的折转线条表达形体张力
features.en: Express tension in the forms through angular lines of varied weight

features.label: Subjective skin color
features.explanation: Use ochre, gray-green, dark red and near-black in uneven, emotionally expressive color patches
features.evidence: The face is not a uniform skin color: ochre, gray-green and warm red marks intersect.
features.zh: 以土黄、灰绿、暗红和近黑组织不均匀的情绪性色块
features.en: Use ochre, gray-green, dark red and near-black in uneven, emotionally expressive color patches

features.label: Uneven shading
features.explanation: Let light and shadow appear slightly broken, emphasizing key expressions and structures
features.evidence: Broken tonal marks on the face contrast with the broad area of dark clothing.
features.zh: 让明暗分布略带断续，突出关键表情和结构
features.en: Let light and shadow appear slightly broken, emphasizing key expressions and structures

features.label: Subjects in open space
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s layout, simplify secondary details and leave quiet open space around the subjects
features.evidence: The figure is concentrated on the right, balanced by the open area and red Chinese lantern fruits on the left.
features.zh: 保留原图布局，简化次要细节，让主体周围有安静的空场
features.en: Keep the source image’s layout, simplify secondary details and leave quiet open space around the subjects

features.label: Broken color marks
features.explanation: Retain dry, broken color marks and areas of exposed ground, avoiding an overpolished finish
features.evidence: Marks on the face, lines in the clothing and exposed pale ground retain a dry quality.
features.zh: 保留干涩、断续的色痕与局部露底，避免过度抛光
features.en: Retain dry, broken color marks and areas of exposed ground, avoiding an overpolished finish

features.label: Inward tension
features.evidence: The eyes look directly at the viewer while the head turns aside, adding a sensitive, tense feeling.
features.zh: 表达克制而敏感的心理张力

features.label: Keep the source palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creating an image, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑或道具；不添加参考图的题字、署名或水印；不改变原图的动作与物件关系
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings or props absent from the source image; do not add inscriptions, signatures or watermarks from the reference; do not alter the source image’s actions or relationships between objects
